symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Calls GatherTags, then UpdateTags, then goes through a list the earlier steps collected (the loop after them was not read through; by the system's own method name RemoveComponents it removes esv::character_creation::AppearanceVisualTagComponent from some entities, which is a guess from the name). GatherTags runs a removed-tag query on eoc::character_creation::AppearanceComponent. UpdateTags, for each collected entity, fetches its AppearanceVisualTagComponent and, when the entity has none, calls a helper that is probably the add (not verified), then fills an array of 16-byte values (GUID-sized) from the gathered data.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll esv::character_creation::AppearanceVisualTagSystem Update (calls GatherTags, UpdateTags), GatherTags header and its query tag, UpdateTags first 45 lines, RemoveComponents first 45 lines (a loop over an entity list with a HasComponent check), all skimmed not traced.
